note: Inventory art, first drafts (23 Nov). The loot sheet's form: name -> box. Sizes in px at 640x360. See README.md.

slot.note: An empty inventory slot. The same size as the satchel's cell (accessories/cell.png), drawn plainer. Slots tile with no gap.

slot_hover.note: The slot under the cursor: pale corner brackets. Ready made, for one player.

slot_cursor.note: The brackets alone, WHITE with a dark inner line: draw it over a slot or a satchel cell and tint it with a player's scarf colour (Art.PLAYER_COLORS) when two players share the screen.

pack_hide.note: The Hide Pack (a backpack: one more row of slots). For the lab and Pip's shop.

satchel_hide.note: The Hide Satchel (a bigger accessory satchel). For the lab and Pip's shop.

item_tin_bar.note: Tin bar. Put 16 px items at (4, 4) in a slot.

item_stone.note: Copied unchanged from tools-v1 (it is already on art/tools/tools.png), so all six materials are in one place.

item_wood.note: Copied unchanged from tools-v1 (it is already on art/tools/tools.png), so all six materials are in one place.

item_tin_ore.note: Copied unchanged from tools-v1 (it is already on art/tools/tools.png), so all six materials are in one place.

item_copper_ore.note: Copied unchanged from tools-v1 (it is already on art/tools/tools.png), so all six materials are in one place.

compass_arrow.note: The Wayfinder's Compass arrow at the screen's edge (added 23 Nov 18:55Z). NOT an animation: eight directions, clockwise from up: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW. Each is lit from the upper left, so use the frame, do not turn one.
